data.one_liner: A TextField widget that converts text to Markdown with a custom toolbar.
data.what_it_does: Provides a text field widget equipped with a toolbar for formatting text into Markdown (bold, italic, lists, headings, links, etc.). It supports features like auto-converting emojis and parsing markdown content.
use_when: You need a text input field with a markdown formatting toolbar.
You want users to easily write and preview markdown text.
avoid_when: You need a fully-featured code or rich text editor beyond standard Markdown.
You only need a static markdown renderer without input capabilities.
strengths: Includes a customizable formatting toolbar out of the box.
Supports auto emoji conversion and multiline formatting.
weaknesses: Limited to markdown editing features defined by the package.
Documentation is sparse outside of basic README usage examples.
